{{Quote|You will plan for me an assault on Ithor to commence a month from now. You will likewise plan a feint in force at the world Agamar. It will fall, or we will take it after we take Ithor. You will plan these assaults, using all the assets assigned to me.|[[Shedao Shai]], to [[Deign Lian]]|<ref name="DTII:R" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Yuuzhan Vong '''conquered''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The attack was ordered by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Shedao Shai]] and executed by [[Deign Lian]] as a feint to attack the New Republic at [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].<ref name="DTII:R" /> The invasion of Agamar occurred just pror to the [[Battle of Ithor]]. Unable to stop the Yuuzhan Vong, the New Republic evacuated most of the population before the invasion.<ref name="TNJOS" />
